parts.text: Monte Alén National Park, established in 1990 on the mainland, covers about 2,000 km2 and shelters central chimpanzees and western lowland gorillas among 15 to 16 primate species. Monte Alén and Monte Mitra, at about 1,250 m, are thought to be the highest massifs of mainland Equatorial Guinea.
